method: Exploratory read-only postprocessing of saved wide65.mat and fine52.mat; no new acoustic solve or material model.
provenance: assumed source and uniform linear lossless medium; actual probe and SonoInk properties unknown
box_membership: Inclusive voxel-centre bounds with 1e-12 m numerical tolerance, matching existing analysis.
limitations: Qp is dt*sum(p^2), not deposited energy or cure. Changing integration boxes keeps the field and target numerator fixed; it does not simulate a thinner material or establish a usable cure threshold. Finite forward search is not all space.
